Symbols:
  Q: volumetric flow rate [m^3/s] (computed)

  Q_{blocked}: volumetric flow rate through the blocked pores [m^3/s] (computed)
  \Delta P: transmembrane pressure (variable)
  \mu: solution viscosity (parameter)
  R_{m}: clean membrane resistance [m^{-1}] (parameter)
  A_{open}: area of the membrane which remains uncovered at any given time [m^2] (computed)
  A_{blocked}: total area of the membrane surface that is blocked by the protein aggregates [m^2] (variable)
  R_{p}: resistance of the protein deposit over a particular region of the membrane [m^{-1}] (computed)
  \alpha: pore blockage parameter equal to the membrane area blocked per unit mass of protein convected to the membrane surface [m^2 kg^{-1}] (parameter)
  C_{b}: bulk protein concentration (variable)
  m_{p}: mass of the protein deposit per unit area (computed)
  f^{\prime}: fraction of the proteins that contribute to the growth of the deposit [-] (parameter)
  J_{blocked}: filtrate flux through each region of the membrane (computed)
  R^{\prime}: proportionality constant relating deposit mass per unit area to hydraulic resistance (parameter)
